Table.CommandText:
SELECT CASE WHEN BRANCH.Code = '00000' THEN N'สำนักงานใหญ่' WHEN BRANCH.Code <> '00000' THEN concat(N'สาขาที่', ' ', BRANCH.Code) END AS 'GLN_H', OIGN.DocEntry, OIGN.DocNum, OIGN.DocDate, NNM1.BeginStr, (IGN1.VisOrder+1) As 'No.', IGN1.ItemCode, IGN1.Dscription, IGN1.Quantity, IGN1.UomCode, IGN1.WhsCode, OIGN.comments, OIGN.U_GR_RE, pj.Project FROM OIGN LEFT JOIN IGN1 ON OIGN.DocEntry = IGN1.DocEntry LEFT JOIN IGN1 pj ON OIGN.DocEntry = IGN1.DocEntry AND pj.Project IS NOT NULL AND pj.Project <> '' LEFT JOIN NNM1 ON OIGN.Series = NNM1.Series LEFT JOIN OPRJ ON pj.Project = OPRJ.PrjCode LEFT JOIN OUSR ON OIGN.UserSign = OUSR.USERID LEFT JOIN [dbo].[@SLDT_SET_BRANCH] BRANCH ON OIGN.U_SLD_LVatBranch = BRANCH.Code WHERE OIGN.DocEntry = {?Dockey@} AND IGN1.basetype <> '202'
ORDER BY IGN1.VisOrder

Table.CommandText: SELECT OIGN.DocEntry, IGN1.ItemCode, OITM.InvntryUom, Serial.SQTY, Serial.SerialNum, Batch_N.BQTY, Batch_N.BatchNum AS 'BATCH', Batch_N.ReceiveDate AS 'Bdate', Batch_N.ExpDate AS 'Bexp' FROM OIGN LEFT JOIN IGN1 ON OIGN.DocEntry = IGN1.DocEntry LEFT JOIN OITM ON IGN1.ItemCode = OITM.ItemCode LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OIGN.CardCode = OCRD.CardCode LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON (OCRD.CardCode = CRD1.CardCode AND OIGN.PayToCode = CRD1.Address AND CRD1.AdresType ='B') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SRI.BaseEntry, SRI.BaseLinNum, SRI.ItemCode, SUM(SN.Quantity) AS SQTY, STRING_AGG(SN.DistNumber, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SN.DistNumber ASC) AS SerialNum FROM SRI1_LINK SRI INNER JOIN OSRN SN ON SRI.SysSerial = SN.SysNumber AND SN.ItemCode = SRI.ItemCode WHERE SRI.BaseType = '59' GROUP BY SRI.BaseEntry, SRI.BaseLinNum, SRI.ItemCode ) AS Serial ON IGN1.DocEntry = Serial.BaseEntry AND IGN1.LineNum = Serial.BaseLinNum AND IGN1.ItemCode = Serial.ItemCode LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IBT.BaseEntry, IBT.BaseLinNum, IBT.ItemCode, SUM(IBT.Quantity) AS BQTY, STRING_AGG(BN.DistNumber, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY BN.DistNumber ASC) AS BatchNum, MAX(COALESCE(BN.MnfDate, BN.InDate)) AS ReceiveDate, MAX(BN.ExpDate) AS ExpDate FROM IBT1_LINK IBT INNER JOIN OBTN BN ON IBT.BatchNum = BN.DistNumber AND IBT.ItemCode = BN.ItemCode WHERE IBT.BaseType = '59' GROUP BY IBT.BaseEntry, IBT.BaseLinNum, IBT.ItemCode ) AS Batch_N ON IGN1.DocEntry = Batch_N.BaseEntry AND IGN1.LineNum = Batch_N.BaseLinNum AND IGN1.ItemCode = Batch_N.ItemCode WHERE OIGN.DocEntry = {?DocKey@} AND IGN1.ItemCode = '{?ItemCode@}' ORDER BY OIGN.DocEntry, IGN1.VisOrder

SqlCommands.SqlCommand: SELECT OIGN.DocEntry, IGN1.ItemCode, OITM.InvntryUom, Serial.SQTY, Serial.SerialNum, Batch_N.BQTY, Batch_N.BatchNum AS 'BATCH', Batch_N.ReceiveDate AS 'Bdate', Batch_N.ExpDate AS 'Bexp' FROM OIGN LEFT JOIN IGN1 ON OIGN.DocEntry = IGN1.DocEntry LEFT JOIN OITM ON IGN1.ItemCode = OITM.ItemCode LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OIGN.CardCode = OCRD.CardCode LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON (OCRD.CardCode = CRD1.CardCode AND OIGN.PayToCode = CRD1.Address AND CRD1.AdresType ='B') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SRI.BaseEntry, SRI.BaseLinNum, SRI.ItemCode, SUM(SN.Quantity) AS SQTY, STRING_AGG(SN.DistNumber, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SN.DistNumber ASC) AS SerialNum FROM SRI1_LINK SRI INNER JOIN OSRN SN ON SRI.SysSerial = SN.SysNumber AND SN.ItemCode = SRI.ItemCode WHERE SRI.BaseType = '59' GROUP BY SRI.BaseEntry, SRI.BaseLinNum, SRI.ItemCode ) AS Serial ON IGN1.DocEntry = Serial.BaseEntry AND IGN1.LineNum = Serial.BaseLinNum AND IGN1.ItemCode = Serial.ItemCode LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IBT.BaseEntry, IBT.BaseLinNum, IBT.ItemCode, SUM(IBT.Quantity) AS BQTY, STRING_AGG(BN.DistNumber, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY BN.DistNumber ASC) AS BatchNum, MAX(COALESCE(BN.MnfDate, BN.InDate)) AS ReceiveDate, MAX(BN.ExpDate) AS ExpDate FROM IBT1_LINK IBT INNER JOIN OBTN BN ON IBT.BatchNum = BN.DistNumber AND IBT.ItemCode = BN.ItemCode WHERE IBT.BaseType = '59' GROUP BY IBT.BaseEntry, IBT.BaseLinNum, IBT.ItemCode ) AS Batch_N ON IGN1.DocEntry = Batch_N.BaseEntry AND IGN1.LineNum = Batch_N.BaseLinNum AND IGN1.ItemCode = Batch_N.ItemCode WHERE OIGN.DocEntry = {?DocKey@} AND IGN1.ItemCode = '{?ItemCode@}' ORDER BY OIGN.DocEntry, IGN1.VisOrder
